description: This is a PHP class file defining the MailMerge class, which handles mail merge operations in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for creating headers, data sources, executing mail merges, and managing temporary files, utilizing COM automation for Word document processing.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: Class responsible for automating mail merge operations using Microsoft Word via COM automation in a SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailMerge object with optional list, field list, and data directory parameters.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge operation, creating the merged document if conditions are met.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Sets the mail merge template if provided as an array.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Removes temporary files and directories created during the mail merge process.

methods.name: CreateHeaderFile
methods.description: Creates a header file for the mail merge process by adding a table with field names.

methods.name: CreateDataSource
methods.description: Creates the data source file that is used during the mail merge operation.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: opens a template, links header and data source files, executes the mail merge, and saves the result.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the COM Word application and prepares temporary directories.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Updates the data list for the mail merge if provided as an array.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Updates the field list for the mail merge if provided as an array.
